Message:
drivers/isdn: eliminate duplicated test

The code checked slot_rx twice.  Check slot_tx by analogy with the bank
case.

The semantic match that finds this problem is as follows:
(http://coccinelle.lip6.fr/)

// <smpl>
@@
expression E;
@@

(
*E && E
|
*E || E
)
// </smpl>
